title: Start from zero robotics
outcome: Build a tiny robot loop in Python, then reason about units, frames, sampling, and the assumptions in a model.

title: Motion and control
outcome: Model a robot's motion, handle limits and singularities, and design feedback and trajectories.

title: Perception and estimation
outcome: Calibrate measurements, estimate a robot's state, and distinguish localization, mapping, and SLAM.

title: Planning and autonomy
outcome: Plan and verify mobile navigation and manipulation, then design what the robot does when a plan fails.

title: Robot software and ROS 2
outcome: Build a ROS 2 workspace, design interfaces, and test delivery, transforms, and replay.

title: Simulation and digital experiments
outcome: Choose a simulator for the question, run a controlled experiment, and connect a virtual sensor to ROS 2.

title: Robot learning
outcome: Compare classical and learned policies, audit demonstrations, and measure performance in closed loop.

title: Infrastructure and operations
outcome: Pin environments, diagnose GPU and DDS boundaries, size storage, and automate reproducible tests.

title: Hardware, real time, and field engineering
outcome: Understand the embedded stack, reason about deadlines, and design a safe commissioning and verification plan.

title: Projects and professional practice
outcome: Build a rover and a tabletop workflow, then turn your tests, traces, and design decisions into portfolio evidence.
